method_detail: CUT3R (Wang et al., CVPR 2025, continuous 3D perception, online recurrent state; handles dynamic scenes); checkpoint cut3r_512_dpt_4_64.pth (sha256 prefix 45f7e98a0a64dbeb)
depth_poses: CUT3R images-only (no intrinsics/poses given); per-frame camera-frame pointmaps pts3d_in_self_view used directly (own predicted geometry, own focal ~650-720 px on 512 grid vs true ~470). Pure-pytorch RoPE2D fallback patched for the pose token position -1 (identical to the CUDA kernel math; verified bit-identical on non-negative positions).
preprocessing: frames read sequentially with cv2.read (md5 per frame in meta.json); centred 544x408 crop inscribed in the scope disc (removes the black vignette, under which CUT3R reconstructs a flat disc), model input 512x384. Variant chosen on DEV render M_G1_s22 frames 0-99 by a rule fixed before running it (all 4 arcs finite on >=90% frames, then min per-frame circle-fit MAD/R); labels unused for the choice. Candidates: crop544x408 0.025, lumen-centred crop 0.026, grey-fill 0.061, mirror-fill 0.137.
readout: radial distance in 3-D about the tube axis (global axis direction = median of per-frame soft-L1 cylinder fits; per-frame axis centre refit with direction fixed); arc membership by IMAGE angle about the dark-lumen centroid (floor 90+-30, roof -90, s90 0, s270 180); arc value = median r in arc / median r at angular distance >50 - 1; lumen (dilated 5 px) and 4-px border excluded.
